name: Spread
description: Width by frequency: the bass held in the middle, the top opened wide, on a curve with points to drag, and it can make width where a sound has none.

params.name: Low
params.description: Width of the bottom of the sound. All the way down the bass sits in the middle and stays firm; halfway is as it came in; up is wider.

params.name: Mid
params.description: Width of the middle of the sound, between the two splits. Halfway leaves it as it came in; down narrows it and up widens it.

params.name: High
params.description: Width of the top of the sound. Up spreads the air and shimmer out to the sides; halfway is as it came in; all the way down the top is in the middle.

params.name: Low split
params.description: Where the bottom ends and the middle begins. Raise it to hold more of the body of the sound to the width set by Low.

params.name: High split
params.description: Where the middle ends and the top begins. Lower it to give more of the sound the width set by High.

params.name: Slope
params.description: How fast a narrowed region gives way at its split. Up it falls steeply and a bass set to the middle stays firm; down it fades gently. Between wide regions it does little.

params.name: Make
params.description: Makes width where a sound has none by scattering its middle to the sides, only where a region is wider than it came. Far up, each speaker alone has dips the other fills.

params.name: Smear
params.description: How long the made width trails each note. Down it is tight against the note; up it is a short haze behind it. It does nothing where Make adds nothing.

params.name: Safe
params.description: Holds the sides under a ceiling against the middle so the sound keeps its body on one speaker. Up holds harder; all the way down is off. It never narrows what came in.

params.name: Output
params.description: The level going out, to make up for what a wider or narrower picture adds or takes.

origin.note: Mid and side; the sides pass two stages of a three region split whose parts are in phase, the middle passes the same split with every gain at 1 so the two stay in step, and the made width is an allpass scatter of the middle under a second curve of what each region has over 1.
